android.desc: Stop wondering where your money goes. Start knowing. Leksy is the budget planner and expense tracker that works 100% offline, keeps your data encrypted on your device, and never shares a single byte with anyone. No account needed. No cloud. No tracking. Track Your Money In Seconds • Add expenses and income with one tap • Scan any receipt (camera, gallery, or PDF) — merchant, amount, and date are read instantly on your phone • Let Android auto-capture bank notifications so transactions log themselves • Track in multiple currencies with live exchange rates See Where Every Dollar Goes • Visual dashboards break down spending by category, week, or month • Smart insights detect unusual spending and alert you before it becomes a habit • Compare month-over-month trends at a glance • Get a weekly spending report every Sunday evening, zero effort Set Budgets That Actually Work • Create budgets per category or for your total spending • Real-time budget health score tells you exactly where you stand • Smart predictions forecast your end-of-month balance based on current pace • Get alerts before you overspend, not after Plan Your Financial Future • Run what-if scenarios: "What if I save $200 more per month?" • Model interest rates, inflation, and compound growth up to 5 years ahead • Set savings goals with visual progress tracking • Track subscriptions so hidden costs stop sneaking past you Manage Loans & Debts • Track money you lent and money you owe, with due dates • Calculate simple or compound interest automatically • Log partial repayments and see your payoff timeline • Monitor your net worth: assets minus liabilities, tracked over time Privacy You Can Verify • Encrypted local database. Your data never leaves your phone • Biometric lock (fingerprint or face) protects the app • Ghost Mode hides all amounts instantly when someone glances at your screen • On-device receipt scanning, no images sent anywhere • Encrypted backups with a password only you know • Zero analytics. Zero tracking. Zero data collection. Export & Report • Generate PDF or CSV reports for any date range • Share reports via email or cloud storage • Perfect for tax prep, reimbursements, or personal review Stays Fun, Stays Consistent • Earn XP and level up from Beginner to Leksy Pro across 15 levels • Unlock 23 achievements: streak milestones, feature mastery, and more • Daily reminders ke
